## Overview

[Record] After Louis I of Hungary and Poland died on 10 Sep 1382, the Lesser Poland lords crowned his daughter [Jadwiga](../characters/jadvyga.qmd) King (16 Oct 1384) and chose [Jogaila](../characters/jogaila.qmd) as her husband at Krėva (14 Aug 1385). Jogaila was baptised Władysław at Kraków on 15 Feb 1386, married Jadwiga on 18 Feb and was crowned on 4 Mar. Jadwiga died on 17 Jul 1399; Jogaila reigned until 1 Jun 1434. Milestones: Vilnius-Radom (1401), Grunwald (15 Jul 1410), Horodło (2 Oct 1413), the crown affair (1429-30), the Jedlnia privilege (4 Mar 1430), Władysław III at Varna (10 Nov 1444), Casimir crowned 25 Jun 1447.

## Wants (by book)

| Book | Goal | Leverage | Red line |
|---|---|---|---|
| I | A king with an army against the Order | The crown; Jadwiga | No Lithuanian kingdom |
| II | Lithuania governed for the Crown; Red Ruthenia | Skirgaila, then Vytautas as lieutenant | Separate Lithuanian title |
| III | Vilnius-Radom reversion; Dobrzyń, then Pomerelia | Polish knights at Grunwald | Losing the union |
| IV | Horodło on Polish terms; no Lithuanian crown | [Oleśnicki](../characters/olesnicki.qmd)'s guards on the Noteć ford (Aug 1430); Sophia's sons | Vytautas crowned |
| V | Podolia, Volhynia; a Polish viceroy in Lithuania | The Podolia grab (Nov 1430); Grodno 1432 | Losing Lithuania to Casimir's council in 1440 |

## Patron Force

[Saga] The [Gold-Glutton](../forces/gold_glutton.qmd) from 1411, and the [White Silence](../forces/white_silence.qmd), fed by baptisms bought for crowns. Jogaila's baptism settles it over Krėva and Vilnius (Book I ch. 28b, 29).

## Internal tensions

Two camps: the Lesser Poland lords (Spytko of Melsztyn, Jan of Tarnów, Oleśnicki) against a Hussite-leaning party (Spytko III of Melsztyn, killed at Grotniki 1439). The lords repeatedly overrule Jogaila: they block the crown (IV ch. 19, 23) and withdraw approval of Švitrigaila (7 Nov 1430).

## Notable members

[Jogaila](../characters/jogaila.qmd), [Jadvyga](../characters/jadvyga.qmd), [Oleśnicki](../characters/olesnicki.qmd).
